title: W-15: publish build provenance for the release and document gh attestation verify
description: Source: the consolidated pre-public security review (opum-doc, 2026-10-30), reviewed at b1dae53374a8c0c3514f015ff77faac9af643e2d; tracked under ODOC-552 and parent WCLI-95. Report id: W-15 (low), ruling W-36. The sha256 and cdhash come from the same release as the binary, so anything that can replace one can replace all three. Ruling W-36: ad-hoc signing done on macOS, verified in the release gate (W-1 task), with build provenance. Release-path change; needs Opus review. Files: .github/workflows/release.yml, README.md, install runbook.

acceptanceCriteria.text: release.yml publishes build provenance with attestations: write and id-token: write
The README and runbook document gh attestation verify ward-darwin-arm64 -R opum-ai/ward-cli
